agreement.sampling_warning: double-review set includes all prior-decision cases plus fixed random subset; not a population reliability estimate
agreement.warning: repeat set is stratified and prior-risk enriched; interval is not population inter-rater reliability

limitations: Offline engineering run is not a quality comparison of real LLMs.
Unknown frequency, meaning, POS, identity and cost are not replaced by zero.
No thresholds learned from the frozen evaluation set. Independent calibration and untouched grouped holdout required.
Model or source agreement does not establish error independence.
Timing is pipeline wall time including preparation; not annotator time or source-hint speedup.

required_followup.adjudications: additional independent third-person reviews where disagreement
required_followup.llm_outputs: same cases and budgets, explicitly authorized provider/local model; models are never gold
